hero.title: A kernel. An opinion.
hero.lead: Studio runs AI agent pipelines via YAML configuration. Open source, declarative, retry-driven. It's voluntary.

thesis.title: What if agent orchestration was configuration, not code?
thesis.lead: Three premises shared with other frameworks. Three inverted by Studio.
thesis.card1_title: A pipeline is a YAML file
thesis.card1_body: Declares stages and groups. Each stage references an agent (runtime config) and a contract (JSON schema + constraints). Modifiable without a programming environment, line by line.
thesis.card2_title: The engine executes via the RALPH loop
thesis.card2_body: Execute → validate → advance if contract passes, retry with enriched feedback if it fails. No stage advances until its contract is met.
thesis.card3_title: Run it 10 times, get 10 correct outputs
thesis.card3_body: That's why contracts and retries exist. Anti-theatre by construction — the agent cannot skip steps that the contract requires.

tradeoffs.lead: LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen share one premise: agent orchestration is code. Studio takes the inverse premise and assumes it.
tradeoffs.note: If your need fits the first three, no need to write Studio. If it doesn't, you write a YAML file reviewable line by line, modifiable without programming environment.

patterns.title: Three patterns.
patterns.lead: Everything is declarative. You describe what you want in YAML, the engine handles orchestration. Wiki Creator and Little Chef rely on it in production.
patterns.p1_body: One stage produces, another critiques. If the critic rejects, the group restarts with accumulated feedback. Max N iterations. Anti-theatre applied to creativity.
patterns.p2_body: Fan-out / fan-in declared in YAML. Stages run concurrently. The engine handles async/await and merge.
patterns.p3_body: The runner tracks tool calls. If the contract requires repo_manager.write_file minimum 1 and the agent calls none, the stage fails. Anti-theatre.

architecture.title: Seven packages, one monorepo.
architecture.title_accent: Each fits in a context window.
architecture.lead: The dependency graph is the architecture.
architecture.anonymizer_desc: PII detection & anonymization before LLM calls.
architecture.runner_desc: LLM calls, tool plugin runtime, multi-provider.
architecture.aside_ralph_body: Execute, validate, retry. Pass advances. Fail retries with enriched feedback.
architecture.aside_kernel_body: The kernel is the politics. Layers that don't know each other. Contracts as the only permitted dependency.

products.title: Two domains. Zero orchestration code.
products.wiki_desc: Extract entities, relations, generate wiki pages from EPUB books. NLP + LLM pipelines.
products.chef_desc: Meal planner. Researches cuisines, develops recipes with nutritional profile, generates grocery lists.

commons.left_body: Studio could have been a startup. The product shape lends itself to it. The opposite choice is deliberate. An AI agent orchestration kernel, captured by a company, becomes the bottleneck of everything flowing through it. Studio is designed so that it cannot be captured.
commons.mech1_body: Any modification used in production must be published under the same license.
commons.mech2_body: The kernel is intended to be owned by a non-profit, non-transferable foundation. The founder's progressive withdrawal is an explicit goal.
commons.mech3_body: Open source kernel (commons) · Support core (hosting, maintenance) · Products powered by Studio (commercial or open source). No commercial entity has authority over the kernel.
commons.quote_after: by design. The license is the mechanism that maintains it.

meta.title: Studio Foundation — Agentic pipeline orchestrator
meta.description: Studio is a domain-agnostic agentic pipeline orchestrator. Execute multi-stage LLM workflows with strict output validation and automatic retry.
